profile.headline: Founder & Software Engineer at Coreva Systems
profile.summary:
I build full-stack web applications with React, Node.js, and REST APIs, and deploy them to the cloud. I hold a B.S. in Computer Engineering with a Software Engineering concentration from UTEL Universidad (4.0 GPA), the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner credential, and I completed the AWS Cloud Institute's Cloud Application Developer track.
Through my company, Coreva Systems, I design and build websites and web apps for small businesses. A landing page I built for Clinica Arias helped grow their new customers by 35%. I'm also building Charlie Code Academy (charliecodeacademy.com), a platform that teaches data structures and algorithms in JavaScript.
In 2024 I was the software developer on a team that placed 5th in an IBM-sponsored hackathon at UTEL.
Before tech, I spent 7+ years in safety-critical transportation, where I was promoted to Driver Trainer and trained new drivers to a 95% certification rate. That work taught me process discipline, clear documentation, and calm problem-solving under pressure, which I bring to building reliable software.
I'm open to junior and entry-level Software Engineer, Full-Stack, and Cloud Developer roles. Fluent in English and Spanish.
Stack: JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Firebase, AWS, Docker, Git, Tailwind CSS
Portfolio: carloscordova.dev · GitHub: github.com/cordovacarlos22

projects.title: Trivia  Quiz Game
projects.description:
This project is a trivia web application that generates trivia questions based on user-selected parameters. Users can modify the difficulty, select the type of response, and choose a category. The application fetches trivia questions from the Open Trivia Database API. Each trivia consists of 10 questions, and users are awarded points for each correct answer.

Features

Generates trivia questions with user-selected parameters (difficulty, response type, category)
Displays 10 trivia questions per session
Shows possible answers for each question
Calculates and displays the final score
"Create new trivia" button to generate a new set of questions
Use of tailwind
Written in ECMAScript 6
Hosted on Vercel

projects.title: TMDB (Movie Search App)
projects.description:
• Developed a movie search platform using React and the TMDB API.
• implemented features such as movie search, detailed movie pages, user rating filters, and pagination for seamless browsing.
• Enhanced user experience through responsive design and friendly error handling.
• Deployed the application to a public URL for wide accessibility.
